processes.daemon: fixture-copied candidate `serve --port <ephemeral> --mode block`; terminated by harness.stop() at script exit (twice per run incl. restart leg)
processes.model_fixture: in-process ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port; shutdown+server_close in _reset_model/stop
processes.browser: headless chromium via Playwright; browser.close() in finally of each phase
processes.host_cli: real `node openclaw.mjs agent --local` short-lived child per native turn; exits with each turn
processes.post_run_check: ps aux over siq-r07 / siq-v6-hermes-post / openclaw.mjs / headless_shell: no batch-owned process remains; pre-existing daemons from other batches (pids 276252 port 42817 since 2026-09-16, 2540314 port 58151 since 2026-09-08) untouched

ports.allocation: all 127.0.0.1 ephemeral via socket.bind(port=0) (daemon) and ThreadingHTTPServer (model fixture); no fixed ports, no collision with the parallel OpenShell matrix
ports.post_run_listeners: ss -tlnp shows only the two pre-existing foreign-batch siq-agent-security listeners above; no batch-owned listener remains

temporary_directories.journey_root: tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=siq-r07-user-journey-) per run — auto-removed; post-run glob confirms none left
temporary_directories.attempt1_diagnostics: /tmp/siq-r07-diagnostics-jwl1h2iv (phase-c TimeoutError, 16 checks) archived into r07-journey.attempt1.failure.json facts, then deleted

host_config_backup_restore.mechanism: journey never targets the real host config root: harness pins HOME=<temp>/home and OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=<temp>/home/.openclaw/openclaw.json; adapter install/uninstall (with its own backup) happens inside the fixture home and is verified by step11 (adapter_state_removed=true, fixture openclaw_json_kept=true)

private_material.journey-private/prereq-checks.json: mode 0600; host/browser/driver preflight facts and pre-run host config digests

public_area_hygiene: public files contain no tokens, pairing codes, credentials or raw tool content (script persists only check ids/statuses/digests by design)
parallel_safety: no foreign sandbox, process, port or directory was modified; on conflict the plan was to switch to another ephemeral port (never needed — allocation is ephemeral)
